Application Data.NAME: Acme Audio Solutions LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Audio Solutions LLC specializes in the sale and service of audio and visual equipment, offering a wide range of products including professional sound systems, home theater setups, and multimedia presentation tools. Our operations include consulting with clients to assess their needs, providing product demonstrations, and delivering installations. We maintain strict inventory controls and utilize a semi-automated system for order processing, ensuring the accuracy of product fulfillment. Additionally, we focus on low cyber exposure by implementing robust IT security measures and partnering with reliable suppliers for our inventory.
